notes.title: Scarecrows of Illyria Update, 7.30.2025
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/fe245532dd48bb8f48e51ef2d1553f0d7bacf31d.png[/img]

We're still working on the rewrite, but have come up with against a wall. For a variety of reasons, some of us would like a new game entirely, much like Joe Papp 2 is just the rewrite of Joe Papp 1, and some of us think the rewrite should still be a patch. 

We are currently debating what the best route is, both financially and creatively. 

We will keep you posted.
